info.title: Sunday War Room API
info.description: Read-only fantasy football assistant API. All data routes live under /api/v1.

get.description: The signed-in user and the leagues they follow.

404.description: Not found (also returned for another user's league)

409.description: Not ready yet (e.g. first sync unfinished, or no team chosen)

delete.description:
Delete the account and everything owned by it.

Memberships, platform links and Auth.js sessions cascade from `users`. Shared league and
NFL data stay: they belong to no single user.

post.description:
Look up a Sleeper username and its leagues for the current season.

Runs in the worker (the API never calls Sleeper during a request). Poll
GET /api/v1/jobs/{job_id}; when done, `result.leagues` lists what can be followed.
